{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print("Duplicate patient_id count:", trial_df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum())

# Check for missing values
print("Missing values per column:")
print(trial_df.isnull().sum())

# Check for implausible values in biomarker_baseline
print("\nBiomarker baseline summary:")
print(trial_df['biomarker_baseline'].describe())

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
sentinel_value = -999.0
print(f"\nCount of sentinel value {sentinel_value} in biomarker_baseline:", (trial_df['biomarker_baseline'] == sentinel_value).sum())"}
